credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Pinus longaeva, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_longaeva . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Pinus longaeva (Great Basin bristlecone pine). LOOMING: a gnarled, wind-twisted trunk of bare, polished silver deadwood on spreading root feet, splitting into contorted limbs: the lead limb reaches out over the foe, the leader ends in a bare dead snag at the top, a rear limb climbs to the right. One living strip of bark spirals up the trunk into the lead limb (outline and mid: scaly black fissures). The living limbs end in dense bottlebrush tufts of short dark needles with small purple cones; frost glints on the deadwood. Gesture: frost glints travel up the deadwood while the needle tufts sway out over the foe, hold, rebound and settle; trunk, roots and snag stay fixed. Weathered silver-lilac mid over a needle green-black dark slot; the polish is white streaks along the grain. Sport: Pinus aristata (Rocky Mountain bristlecone), a close relative's palette.
